changes: Hardened the usage ledger against Object.prototype pollution: new leaf core/usage-ledger/sanitize.ts (toOwnPropsNullProto null-proto+whitelist projection, ownProp), used for token READS at the entry points (assemble extractRawUsage, dispatch extractAnthropicUsage, streaming); raw.payloadDigest now computed over the ORIGINAL raw payload (not the projection) in all adapters incl streaming so legitimate records with extra non-read fields are byte-identical; own-prop guards on every external container read (envelope.usage/model/result, stream usage/usageMetadata/message); ALL residual in-operator presence reads converted to hasOwnProperty incl the record.ts validator (mechanism-only); 30-check prototype-pollution smoke.
usage: No user-facing CLI change — internal defense-in-depth. Maintainers: read token fields off external/parsed objects ONLY through sanitize.ts toOwnPropsNullProto (project for reads) and ownProp (container/presence guards); compute payloadDigest over the ORIGINAL payload (canonicalJson is own-only, pollution-safe + preserves extra fields). Run node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-prototype-pollution-smoke.js to verify (30 checks).
expectedOutcome: No inherited/polluted Object.prototype token value can reach a persisted ledger record on any path (anthropic/openai/gemini + streaming + estimate + the record validator); legitimate records stay byte-identical (payloadDigest preserved); no key-in-obj prototype-chain presence read remains in core/usage-ledger.
actualTranscript: node usage-ledger-prototype-pollution-smoke.js -> "usage-ledger-prototype-pollution smoke passed (30 checks)" exit 0 (23 LOAD-BEARING, driving the real persisted assemble/dispatch/record/streaming paths); DIGEST-PRESERVED checks confirm byte-identical payloadDigest for payloads with extra fields; CONTAINER/result/validator pollution checks confirm inherited values rejected; full npm test ALL PASS; exhaustive grep (codex + concept) shows zero key-in-obj reads remain.
outcomeDiff: No diff: actual matches expected; every load-bearing pollution check fails against pre-hardening code (verified by revert-experiments).
limitations: Honest defense-in-depth, NOT a live vuln (JSON.parse does not mutate Object.prototype; no in-repo code writes it). diagnostics.ts internal-table bracket lookups left as-is (internal data, spec marks optional). The estimate-path smoke check is a property assertion, NOT load-bearing (estimate never reads provider token keys).
pitfalls: canonicalJson uses Object.keys (own-only), so digest the ORIGINAL payload — NEVER a whitelist projection (the projection drops legitimate extra fields like total_tokens/totalTokenCount and silently changes payloadDigest; this was the F-005/F-007 regression). The chokepoint must guard the CONTAINER read too, not just leaf fields (an inherited container object passes the whitelist via its own props — F-004/F-008). Keep per-provider whitelists in ONE place (import from adapters) to avoid drift (F-006/F-010).
